status: approved by the user on 23 October 2026
description: Retrieval benchmark for the Administration of Criminal Justice Act 2015 (as enacted, historical edition). Each query names the one provision that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against the ACJA release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday wording with legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 23 October 2026.

queries.query: What is the purpose of the Administration of Criminal Justice Act?
Must the police tell me why I am being arrested?
Can the police arrest my brother because they cannot find me?
Is torture of a suspect in custody allowed?
queries.note: s.8(1)(b) no torture or degrading treatment.

queries.query: Can someone be arrested over a debt or breach of contract?
queries.note: s.8(2) no arrest merely on a civil wrong.

queries.query: What details must the police record when they arrest someone?
Can my lawyer be present when the police take my statement?
Can an ordinary citizen arrest someone they see committing a crime?
Must police send records of arrests to the Attorney-General?
Can the police grant bail to someone arrested without a warrant?
What can I do if I am held by the police for more than 24 hours without bail?
queries.note: s.32(1) application to court after 24 hours.

queries.query: Do magistrates inspect police stations and cells?
queries.note: s.34 monthly inspection by Chief Magistrate.

queries.query: Is everyone accused of a crime entitled to bail?
Can a person charged with murder or another capital offence get bail?
queries.note: s.161 bail for capital offences only in exceptional circumstances.

queries.query: When can a court refuse bail for an offence carrying more than three years in prison?
Can bail conditions be excessive?
How does plea bargaining work under the ACJA?
How does the prosecution ask a magistrate to remand a suspect?
How long can a suspect be kept on remand before trial?
Can a criminal trial be stayed while an appeal is pending?
Can a criminal court order compensation for the victim?
queries.note: s.314 compensation to victim in judgment.

queries.query: What happens if someone falsely accuses me and gets me arrested?
queries.note: s.323 compensation for false and vexatious accusation.

queries.query: How many adjournments are allowed in a criminal trial?
How is the death penalty carried out in Nigeria?
Can a person sentenced to death ask for the prerogative of mercy?
queries.note: s.409 request to committee on prerogative of mercy.

queries.query: What happens if a woman sentenced to death is pregnant?
queries.note: s.415 pregnancy of woman convicted of capital offence.

queries.query: Can a court give community service instead of prison?
queries.note: s.460 suspended sentence and community service.

queries.query: Can a prisoner on a long sentence be released early for good behaviour?
queries.note: s.468 release after one-third of sentence (parole).

queries.query: Who sits on the Administration of Criminal Justice Monitoring Committee?
How does a company plead to a criminal charge?
What is the penalty for a witness who ignores a court summons?
queries.note: s.246 penalty on witnesses refusing to attend.

queries.query: Can court proceedings be recorded electronically?
queries.note: s.364 electronic or written record of evidence.

queries.query: Can the public be excluded when a child gives evidence in a sexual offence case?
queries.note: s.260 exclusion while a child gives evidence.

queries.query: How long does a private person have to file a complaint for a summary offence?
ACJA section 296 remand time limits
